title: Comet Courier
pitch: A rooftop courier whose comet tail heats up with speed and smashes through anything once it blazes.

title: Blinkwisp
pitch: A lamplighter who never jumps or fights; she throws her wisp of light and blinks to wherever it is.

title: Zenith Rush
pitch: A swift whose weak gun is backed by a parry ring that flings enemy bullets home; kill chains speed up the sky.

title: Drumfort
pitch: A wind-up keep whose whole garrison sits on a turning drum; spin your rows to swing every gun onto the lane in trouble.

title: Sumspire
pitch: A jelly who swallows any foe with a smaller number and adds it to her own; every bite makes her bigger and heavier, so the fastest climb eats only what it must.

title: Counterfall
pitch: A ballast-runner who cannot jump flips which way is down, and every iron weight in the room falls with her.

title: Cinderhook
pitch: A matchstick acrobat whose grappling rope is her own fuse; it burns shorter every moment she hangs, so the fastest line never lingers.

title: Deepset
pitch: A mason's apprentice dives down a deep bore firing wet mortar; every shot sets in stone, paving spikes and slag into ledges and turning foes into blocks to stand on.

title: Hushbeat
pitch: A cat burglar sneaks through a city that marches to one song; every treasure she pockets speeds the song up, guards and lights and all.
